audit.why: 53.39% and 6/10 difficulty are consistent: Kennen owns levels 1-3, the lane levels off at 4-6, Gangplank takes over on first item. The prose already says this.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts had Level 1 as 'Skill' and both item stages as Kennen, contradicting the packet chart AND the page's own text ('Levels 1-3 are his, flat out'; 'your first-item Sheen+keg spike flips the lane and the late game is yours').
audit.why: The three flips are exactly the stages the prose describes; leaving them made the chart argue with the article beside it.
audit.corrected: win[0] and phases[0].side -> Kennen; win[5], win[6], phases[5].side, phases[6].side -> Gangplank, with ratings and whys realigned. Proposed as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three ability errors. (1) tldr/report[0] say 'Q-cleanse his slows' — Gangplank cleanses with Remove Scurvy (W), not Q, and Kennen has no slow in his kit; his CC is the three-mark stun. (2) The whole full layer is built around 'Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — his escape', but Lightning Rush is a 170-range movement form; the ability that decides this lane is Thundering Shuriken (950 range, 7s falling to 4s) stacking Mark of the Storm. (3) whys[4], spikes[3].text, mid and wants.you[2] all claim a 'right-click cancel' clears the Slicing Maelstrom stun. Right-clicking does not clear a stun; Remove Scurvy does.
audit.why: Each one tells the player to do something that does not work. The 'right-click cancel' line is the worst — it invites a player to eat a full ult believing he can click his way out.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, report[0], report[1], report[5], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], dontsFull rebuilt around Thundering Shuriken's 7s cooldown and mark counting; the right-click-cancel claim removed from whys[4], spikes[3].text, mid and wants.you[2] in favour of Remove Scurvy.
sources: ownerKit W text 'cure crowd control effects'

audit.whatIsWrong: Electrical Surge (W) applies on-hit and is driven by attack speed; nothing on the page mentions it.
audit.why: Armour alone misreads these trades, and it changes what Mercury's Treads is buying you.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you stabilize: extra points in Parrrley and Powder Keg let you detonate a keg with Q from range and finally trade back instead of just bleeding. At 6 respect his Slicing Maelstrom — it tags you with marks fast and stuns for a dive, so keep W (or a right-click cancel) ready to clear it and don't get caught arming a keg near your tower with his jungler missing. This stage is roughly even; you're not all-inning yet, you're surviving to your Sheen spike.
